scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project crewday-rules-test "vitest run --project rules"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:dom && npm run test:rules
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:dom && npm run build
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run test:rules
scripts.rules:dev: node scripts/use-rules.mjs dev && firebase deploy --only firestore:rules,storage
scripts.rules:prod: node scripts/use-rules.mjs prod && firebase deploy --only firestore:rules,firestore:indexes,storage
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:apk:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew bundleRelease
